#!/usr/bin/python
# -*- coding: UTF-8 -*-
#Author:R3start
#这是一个用于IP和域名碰撞匹配访问的小工具

import re

import requests
from requests.packages import urllib3

from lib.domain import Host, ScanTarget
from lib.network import HttpClient


def main():
    urllib3.disable_warnings()
    
    hosts = []
    with open('host.txt', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        hosts = [Host(name=line.strip()) for line in f if line.strip()]
    
    targets = []
    with open('ip.txt', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        targets = [ScanTarget(ip=line.strip()) for line in f if line.strip()]
    
    success_list = []
    
    with open('hosts_ok.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as out_file:
        print("====================================开 始 匹 配====================================")
        
        client = HttpClient()
        
        for target in targets:
            for scheme in ['http://', 'https://']:
                for host in hosts:
                    url = scheme + target.ip
                    headers = {
                        'Host': host.name,
                        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; WOW64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/62.0.3202.94 Safari/537.36'
                    }
                    try:
                        response = client.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=5, verify=False)
                        response.encoding = 'utf-8'
                        title_match = re.search(r'<title>(.*)</title>', response.text)
                        title = title_match.group(1) if title_match else ""
                        info = f"{target.ip} -- {host.name} 协议：{scheme} 数据包大小：{len(response.text)} 标题：{title}"
                        success_list.append(info)
                        out_file.write(info + "\n")
                        print(info)
                    except Exception:
                        error = f"{target.ip} --- {host.name} --- 访问失败！~"
                        print(error)
        
        print("====================================匹 配 成 功 的 列 表====================================")
        for item in success_list:
            print(item)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
